verdict.rationale: Undermind runs deep literature reviews that plan their own searches and stop autonomously (undermind-docs-4, undermind-docs-16), implying long unattended jobs, and offers alerts for newly published relevant papers (undermind-docs-9), but there is no explicit documentation of a persistent 'job' model with completion notifications for a single long-running research task, nor hands-on confirmation of unattended job completion alerts. missing for 10: explicit documentation/UI of a long-running async job queue, confirmation of notification-on-completion (email/push) for a single research run, and independent/community verification of this unattended workflow.
